canon: Colgante cosmético de cintura de los clanes de las Llanuras: cordel con piezas de hueso (colmillos de la primera cacería, vértebras de gargantúa).

capas.notas: IMG-54, plantilla por capas (scripts/capas.py): forma sin color en los campos de lápiz; color, paleta y luz solo en el paso a foto. Del estudio: «ivory-yellow» da amarillo plástico; «a loop» cierra el cordel; el entorno de uso hace el banner; el tamaño de las piezas pequeñas no se sigue.
capas.sujeto: Close-up of a hunting amulet lying on a flat stone, the amulet filling the middle of the image from left to right.
capas.forma: A long thick cord of braided leather sags across the stone in a wide open curve from the left side of the image to the right. Strung along the lowest part of the curve like beads hang a row of many small knobbly bone vertebrae and four curved fangs about as long as a finger, pointing down. The bone is old, chipped and worn, with carved grooves.
capas.entorno: The flat stone lies on a rough wooden workbench with a few bone-carving tools and more amulets hanging from a peg. Behind the workbench, out of focus, the posts and hide walls of a tent, and on the right an open view of a dry plain with grass tufts and a flat-topped mesa in the distance.
capas.color: The leather cord is dark brown. The bone is dirty off-white, stained brown in its carved grooves, and dusty. The tent hides are red-brown; the plain is red earth with straw-yellow grass tufts and a red mesa far away.
capas.paleta: bone off-white, leather brown and rust red
capas.luz: Warm clear daylight from the right, shallow depth of field, gritty weathered textures everywhere.
